# Mountain Ecosystem
> A dedicated Pan-India SaaS platform for mountain properties (for lease and sale), mountain jobs with accommodation, and community field experiences across Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Ladakh, Jammu & Kashmir, Sikkim, Bengal Hills, and the Nilgiris.

## Core Platform Modules
- [Property Lease & Sale]: Verified stone cottages, cedar chalets, and mountain parcels with full verified addresses, monthly lease terms (1–12 months), and outright purchase terms with clear titles.
- [Mountain Jobs & Recruitment]: Employment exchange where mountain employers post openings with dignified wages, free mountain lodging, and organic meals.
- [Community Experiences & Price Index]: Verified ground transit benchmarks (shared Bolero and Sumo fares, bus rates, porter daily wage caps) and trail weather advisories.
- [Anaya AI Concierge]: Grounded AI assistant offering instant answers regarding property leases, job openings, transport rates, and ecological guidelines across all Indian mountain states.

## Geographic Coverage
- Himachal Pradesh: Manali, Parvati Valley, Spiti, Tirthan Valley, Dharamshala, Kullu
- Uttarakhand: Mukteshwar, Chopta, Mussoorie, Almora, Kumaon, Garhwal
- Ladakh & Kashmir: Leh, Nubra Valley, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Zanskar
- Sikkim & Northeast: Gangtok, Yuksom, Dzongu, Tawang, Shillong
- Bengal Hills: Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Kurseong, Takdah
- Nilgiris & Western Ghats: Ooty, Kotagiri, Kodaikanal, Coorg, Munnar
